events.name: doras.door_opened
events.when: Front Door opens, after someone presses Continue with Atmosphere.

events.name: doras.account_found
events.when: An account is found for what someone typed or chose.

events.name: doras.account_not_found
events.when: Nothing is found for what someone typed.

events.name: doras.sign_in_started
events.when: Front Door hands over to the provider's sign-in page.

events.name: doras.signed_in
events.when: On the provider's page, someone proves who they are.

events.name: doras.existing_account_found
events.when: The existing-account check finds an account someone may already have.

events.name: doras.provider_chosen
events.when: Someone chooses a provider to host their new account.

typed_address.description: Whether they typed a provider's address instead of choosing from the list.

events.name: doras.account_created
events.when: The provider finishes making the new account.

events.name: doras.connect_approved
events.when: On the Connect page, someone connects the app to their account.

version.description: The full page, for a first connection, or the short one.

events.name: doras.connect_cancelled
events.when: On the Connect page, someone chooses not to connect.

events.name: doras.passkey_offered
events.when: The offer to add a passkey is shown.

events.name: doras.passkey_declined
events.when: Someone chooses not to add a passkey now.

events.name: doras.recovery_started
events.when: Someone says they've forgotten their handle.

events.name: doras.recovery_email_requested
events.when: The check-your-email step is shown. It never says whether an account exists.

providers_asked.description: How many providers were asked to send the email.

events.name: doras.recovery_completed
events.when: The sign-in code from the email is accepted.

events.name: doras.failure_shown
events.when: One of the four failure states is shown.
